---
title: "R Notebook QoM MP/Vicon"

---



```{r}
# =========================
# QoM validity: MediaPipe vs Vicon
# =========================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(psych)
library(writexl)
library(scales)

# -------------------------
# 1) Path
# -------------------------

DATA_PATH <- "Stats.xlsx"

# Vérifier que le fichier est bien trouvé
print(file.exists(DATA_PATH))

data <- read_excel(DATA_PATH)

print(names(data))

# -------------------------
# 2) Variables
# -------------------------

qom_vars <- tibble(
  segment = c("Wrist", "Head"),
  mp_col = c("MQI_WRIST_MP", "MQI_HEAD_MP"),
  vicon_col = c("MQI_WRIST_VICON", "MQI_HEAD_VICON")
)

# -------------------------
# 3) Fonction stats
# -------------------------

compute_qom_validity <- function(data, mp_col, vicon_col, segment_name) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    select(all_of(mp_col), all_of(vicon_col)) %>%
    rename(
      MP = all_of(mp_col),
      VICON = all_of(vicon_col)
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  r_test <- cor.test(df$MP, df$VICON, method = "pearson")
  
  diff <- df$MP - df$VICON
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(diff^2))
  bias <- mean(diff)
  sd_diff <- sd(diff)
  loa_lower <- bias - 1.96 * sd_diff
  loa_upper <- bias + 1.96 * sd_diff
  
  icc_res <- psych::ICC(df[, c("MP", "VICON")])
  
  tibble(
    segment = segment_name,
    n = nrow(df),
    r = unname(r_test$estimate),
    r_CI_lower = r_test$conf.int[1],
    r_CI_upper = r_test$conf.int[2],
    p_value = r_test$p.value,
    R2 = unname(r_test$estimate)^2,
    ICC_2_1 = icc_res$results[2, "ICC"],
    ICC_lower = icc_res$results[2, "lower bound"],
    ICC_upper = icc_res$results[2, "upper bound"],
    RMSE = rmse,
    bias_MP_minus_VICON = bias,
    LoA_lower = loa_lower,
    LoA_upper = loa_upper
  )
}

# -------------------------
# 4) Calcul des stats QoM
# -------------------------

qom_results <- qom_vars %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    stats = list(
      compute_qom_validity(
        data = data,
        mp_col = mp_col,
        vicon_col = vicon_col,
        segment_name = segment
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(stats) %>%
  unnest(stats)

print(qom_results)

# -------------------------
# 5) Format long pour figures
# -------------------------

qom_long <- qom_vars %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    data_long = list(
      data %>%
        select(all_of(mp_col), all_of(vicon_col)) %>%
        rename(
          MP = all_of(mp_col),
          VICON = all_of(vicon_col)
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          segment = segment,
          mean_systems = (MP + VICON) / 2,
          diff_MP_minus_VICON = MP - VICON
        ) %>%
        drop_na()
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(data_long) %>%
  unnest(data_long)

# -------------------------
# 6) Scatterplots
# -------------------------

p_scatter <- ggplot(qom_long, aes(x = VICON, y = MP)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ segment, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "QoM: MediaPipe vs Vicon",
    x = "Vicon QoM (mm)",
    y = "MediaPipe QoM (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

print(p_scatter)

ggsave(
  filename = "qom_scatter_MP_vs_VICON.png",
  plot = p_scatter,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

# -------------------------
# 7) Bland-Altman plots
# -------------------------

p_ba <- ggplot(qom_long, aes(x = mean_systems, y = diff_MP_minus_VICON)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ segment, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Bland-Altman plots for QoM",
    x = "Mean of MediaPipe and Vicon QoM (mm)",
    y = "MediaPipe - Vicon QoM (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

print(p_ba)

ggsave(
  filename = "qom_bland_altman.png",
  plot = p_ba,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

# -------------------------
# 8) Export résultats
# -------------------------

write_xlsx(
  list(
    qom_results = qom_results,
    qom_long = qom_long
  ),
  "qom_validity_results.xlsx"
)
```
